verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The barrel photo, which is the hero image, is shrunk to a thumbnail and jammed beside a tiny logo and a stray dash under the headline. A torn-paper texture fragment floats on its own with no purpose, and the tagline is squeezed against the right edge. The headline, logo and tagline are spread across the banner with no grouping or hierarchy. A is marginally better only because its texture sits on the left margin, while B's floats at an arbitrary point.
